scope: Existing planned_preview with disposable in-memory grid/residential policy injection; preserves unrelated candidates. No registration, expedition or frequency claim.

objects.name: stone inscription
objects.description: A heavy inscribed fragment. Broken from something larger.

items.name: clay lump
items.description: A handful of river clay, dense and slightly damp. Takes any shape pressed into it. Dries hard near heat.

items.name: Crow Jerky
items.description: Strips of dried crow meat. It tastes exactly as you would expect. It sustains you regardless.

objects.name: a letter
objects.description: Folded paper. Someone meant to send this.

objects.name: dried provisions
objects.eat_message: Dry and tasteless. It does what it needs to.
objects.description: A cloth parcel of preserved travel rations. Salt-stiff, dense, neutral. Someone prepared this for a journey they did not finish.

objects.name: water skin
objects.drink_message: Cold and flat. The thirst retreats.
objects.description: A leather skin, filled with water. The hide is old but the stitching holds. Something alive is in it still.

objects.name: bundle of wood
objects.description: A loose bundle of dry branches. Snapped from dead fall.
